sections.name: Kia Seltos
lines: The Kia Seltos is one of India's most popular mid size SUVs, and the car that launched Kia in India in 2019.
Three engines. A one point five petrol, a one point five turbo petrol with a hundred and sixty P S, and a one point five diesel.
The turbo makes two hundred and fifty three newton metres, and pairs with a dual clutch automatic.
Depending on the engine, you get manual, C V T, dual clutch or torque converter automatics.
Inside, two ten point two five inch screens sit in one curved panel.
Level two driver assistance. Adaptive cruise, lane keeping, and automatic emergency braking.
Plus a panoramic sunroof, a three sixty camera, ventilated seats, and six airbags as standard.
If you want the most features for your money in this class, the Seltos is hard to beat.
